text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein and French President Jacques Chirac discuss the peace process and the European role; both leaders emphasise necessity of easing the plight of the Iraqi people.

- Crown Prince Hassan during talks with Turkish President Suleyman Demirel states Jordan's refusal to "accept any change in the region's map" and stresses the importance of dialogue and consultation to end regional conflict.
- Union leaders decide to go back on their resignation in protest at the new press law in the interests of the country, they say.
- Crown Prince Hassan's talks in Ankara focus on the Middle East peace process, the situation in northern Iraq and proposals to set up joint ventures.
